title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics telemetry & runbook linking improvements
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers asked for richer, correlated telemetry when the incident-bot runs automated diagnostics and links runbooks during on-call flows. This PR adds structured telemetry events, improves runbook-linking heuristics, and surfaces a short summary card in Slack/Teams with diagnostic scores so responders can triage faster.

What I changed (high level): added diagnostic telemetry events (diagnostic.started/finished/score), attach runbook metadata (id, confidence, matching-clauses) to the notification payload, emit an aggregated diagnostic.summary metric for SLO correlation, and added a small synthetic probe that exercises the runbook-linker in CI. Also added RBAC check gating in the private-installer integration path to avoid NS leaks in private deployments.

Checklist:
- [x] Add telemetry schema + migration note
- [x] Implement telemetry emission in runbook and diagnostics flow
- [x] Update Slack/Teams message formatter to include concise diagnostic card
- [x] Add unit + integration tests (includes synthetic runbook linker probe)
- [x] Add release note
- [x] Code review and address feedback

Backward compatibility: All telemetry additions are additive. Existing notification payloads preserve current fields; diagnostic metadata is in an opt-in field ("diagnostic_meta") configurable via INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGNOSTIC_META=true.

Testing: local unit tests + new integration test against the runbook matcher (mocks SLO toolkit). CI ran unit, lint, integration and e2e smoke; one flaky e2e was retried and passed. Manually validated Slack card rendering in staging and verified metrics emitted to the dev metrics cluster.

Rollout and ops notes: feature guarded by INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGNOSTIC_META and feature flag in console. No DB schema changes. If telemetry causes noise, toggle the env var to opt out immediately.

Related work: builds on SRE-87 improvements to runbook scoring and references ENG-4021 for runbook metadata standardization.

release_notes: Add structured diagnostic telemetry and improved runbook linking: operators can now see diagnostic scores and runbook confidence in on-call notifications; feature is opt-in via INCIDENT_BOT_DIAGNOSTIC_META. Includes RBAC gating for private installs.
testing_notes: Unit + integration tests added. CI includes synthetic runbook probe. One flaky e2e retried once in CI (now stable). Manual staging verification of Slack/Teams card performed.
risk_assessment: low-medium: additive telemetry with feature flag; RBAC change confined to private-installer path. Monitoring added to detect noise or excessive event volume.
